title: Deep learning radiomics based on multimodal MRI for preoperative prediction of N stage in tongue squamous cell carcinoma: a multicenter study.
summary: Multimodal MRI model predicts preoperative clinical outcomes with a held-out center cohort.
organization: The Affiliated Cancer Hospital of Xiangya School of Medicine; Central South University; Guangzhou Red Cross Hospital of Jinan University

evidence.tested: The paper reports the relevant cohort/image/field dataset, comparator or reference, and validation/test evaluation; the judgment does not imply prospective clinical benefit.
evidence.unknown: The reported evaluation does not establish prospective benefit or performance beyond the studied setting.
evidence.ai_role: Extracts radiomic and learned imaging features from multimodal MRI to classify pathological N stage in tongue squamous-cell carcinoma.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
